description: Create a free page-view tracker for a website. Returns the tag image URL and ready-to-paste snippets for the site's pages, plus the stats URL where views, visitors, pages and referrers are shown. When signed in, the tracker belongs to the account; otherwise keep the manage_token to claim it later.

name.description: Optional display name for the tracker.

site_url.description: The site's address, e.g. example.com. Views are only counted on this domain and its subdomains.

name: create_tracker
title: Create a page-view tracker
